headline: Requests from Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant and Broadview Holdings, LLC for locations on Lovell and Claremont streets.
summary: The agenda lists one common victualler request from Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant at 117 Lovell Street. Broadview Holdings, LLC has two lodging house requests, for 16 and 18 Claremont Street.
items: Icy Gaming Mart Restaurant, 117 Lovell Street: common victualler request, with service hours 11 Am to 12 Sunday through Thursday and 11 Am to 2 am Friday and Saturday
Broadview Holdings, LLC, 16 Claremont Street: lodging house request
Broadview Holdings, LLC, 18 Claremont Street: lodging house request
location: 25 Meade Street, First Floor Conference Room
